name: VAL-05 anonymized observation codebook
rule: One row per task and condition. Use only the columns and codes in this file. No free text, quotes, document excerpts, personal paths, prompts, recordings or identifiers.
session_id_pattern: S01 through S99; never a name

persona_codes.developer: Code editing and workspace search workflow
persona_codes.note_taker: Tags, wikilinks, backlinks and daily notes workflow
persona_codes.privacy_sensitive: Recovery and AI consent decision workflow

task_ids.T01: First-run install, synthetic open and uninstall
task_ids.T05: Compare, review, accept or reject and undo
task_ids.T06: Tag, wikilink, backlink and daily-note navigation
task_ids.T08: Recovery and AI consent decision without a live send
task_ids.T10: Keyboard-only core path and focus behavior
task_ids.T11: Narrator and NVDA names, roles and announcements
task_ids.T12: Scaling, forced colors and minimum window

display_codes.forced_colors: Windows forced colors or high contrast
display_codes.not_applicable: Display condition not varied for this row

completion_codes.with_prompt: Completed after a neutral repeat of the task

comprehension_codes.not_asked: No comprehension question for this row

severity_codes.high: Core task blocked or unsafe state misunderstood
severity_codes.blocker: Potential data loss, inaccessible core path or consent failure

finding_codes.FOCUS_TRAP: Focus cannot leave or return predictably
finding_codes.UNLABELED_CONTROL: Control, dialog or state lacks a usable name
finding_codes.STATE_COLOR_ONLY: Active, dirty or stale state relies on color alone
finding_codes.LAYOUT_CLIPPED: Control is clipped, overlapped or unreachable
finding_codes.STATUS_NOT_ANNOUNCED: Progress, error or status is not announced
finding_codes.SAVED_UNSAVED_CONFUSION: Saved versus unsaved state is unclear
finding_codes.EXTERNAL_CHANGE_CONFUSION: Disk versus draft recovery choice is unclear
finding_codes.SEARCH_SOURCE_UNCLEAR: Disk versus unsaved search result is unclear
finding_codes.REVIEW_UNCLEAR: Diff, accept, reject or undo is unclear
finding_codes.NOTE_NAVIGATION_UNCLEAR: Tags, links, backlinks or daily notes are unclear
finding_codes.PREVIEW_UNCLEAR: Preview discovery or inert behavior is unclear
finding_codes.AI_DESTINATION_UNCLEAR: Local versus cloud destination is unclear
finding_codes.AI_CONSENT_UNCLEAR: Consent, payload or cancellation is unclear
finding_codes.RECOVERY_PRIVACY_UNCLEAR: Local recovery storage or deletion is unclear
finding_codes.INSTALL_UNINSTALL_UNCLEAR: Install, uninstall or file ownership is unclear
finding_codes.SETTINGS_UNCLEAR: Setting discovery, change or restore is unclear
finding_codes.OTHER_REDACTED: Use only with a separate synthetic reproduction; never quote the participant

analysis_gate: At least five distinct sessions, all five personas, every required display and assistive condition, and every core task must be present before a product decision can change, be confirmed or be explicitly rejected.
